ayahOccurrences.text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

ayahOccurrences.text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ آمَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا

lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/م/ع   s–m–ʿ to hear, to listen
; fame.

Of this root, 11 forms occur 185 times in the Qur’an:
سَمِع samiʿa 78 times; أسْمَع ʾasmaʿa 11 times; أسْمِع ʾasmiʿ 2 times;يَسَّمّعون yassammaʿūn 1 time;اسْتَمَعَ ʾistamaʿa 16 times; سَمْع samʿ 22 times; سَميع samıʿ 47 times; سَمّاعون sammāʿūn 4 times; مُسْمِع musmiʿ 1 time; مُسْمَع musmaʿ 1 time and مُسْتَمِع mustamiʿ 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
سَمْع samʿ [n./v. n.]

1 the sense of hearing

(32:9) ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالأَبْصَارَ then He moulded him; He breathed His spirit into him; He gave you hearing, sight…

2 (act of) hearing

(18:101) الَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَاءٍ عَنْ ذِكْرِي وَكَانُوا لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا those whose eyes were blind to My signs, those who were unable to hear

3 overhearing

(26:212) إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ indeed they are barred from [over] hearing; *

(72:9) مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ listening posts [lit. seats for listening]; *

(15:18) اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ مَن he who eavesdrops; *

(26:223) يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ they readily lend an ear to, they listen in.

entries.label: أسْمَعَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أسْمَعَ ʾasmaʿa [v. IV, trans.]

1 to cause someone to hear, to reach the hearing of

(43:40) أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ can you [Prophet] make the deaf hear?

2 to give the ability of hearing to

(8:23) وَلَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لأََسْمَعَهُمْ if God had known there was any good in them, He would have made them able to hear.

entries.label: أسْمِع
entries.definitionHtml:
أسْمِع بِـ ʾasmiʿ bi [exclamation (also possibly the imperative of أسْمَعَ ʾasmaʿa)] ‘How sharp of hearing!’

(19:38) أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ how sharp of hearing, how sharp of sight [they are]!

entries.label: اسْتَمَعَ
entries.definitionHtml:
اسْتَمَعَ ʾistamaʿa I [v. VIII, intrans.]

1 to listen in

(72:1) أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ it has been revealed to me that a company of the jinn listened in [on a recitation of the Qur’an]

2 [with prep. ﻟ] to listen to, to accept and obey

(20:13) وَأَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَى I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed II [v. VIII, trans.] to hear

(21:2) مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ مُحْدَثٍ إِلاَّ اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ whatever new revelation comes to them from their Lord, they but hear it while they are playing.

entries.label: سَميع
entries.definitionHtml:
سَميع samıʿ [intens. act. part.] sharp of hearing

(76:2) إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الإِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا We create man from a drop of mingled sperm‐fluid, putting him to the test; so We made him sharp of hearing, sharp of seeing; *

(2:127) السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ [an attribute of God] the All‐Hearing, the Giver of Hearing.

entries.label: سَمِع
entries.definitionHtml:
سَمِع samiʿa a [v. trans.]

1 to hear

(24:16) وَلَوْلاَ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُمْ مَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَذَا if only when you heard it you had said, ‘It is not [proper] for us to speak of this!’; *

(2:171) ِمَا لاَ يَسْمَعُ إِلاَّ دُعَاءً وَنِدَاءً a dumb animal [lit. one who hears nothing but a shout and a cry]

2 [with prep. ﺒ] to hear of

(12:31) فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ so when she heard of their malicious talk, she sent for them

3 to have the faculty of hearing

(19:42) لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لاَ يَسْمَعُ وَلاَ يُبْصِرُ why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see?!

4 to listen

(41:26) وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لاَ تَسْمَعُوا لِهَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ the disbelievers say, ‘Do not listen to this Qur’an’

5 to obey, to listen to

(36:25) إِنِّي ءَامَنْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ I believe in your Lord, so listen to me/obey me

6 to know, to acknowledge

(58:1) قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ God has heard the words of the one who disputes with you [Prophet] concerning her husband and complains to God.

entries.label: سَمّاع
entries.definitionHtml:
سَمّاع sammāʿ [intens. act. part.]

1 one given to listening

(5:42) سَمَّاعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ listening eagerly to falsehood

2 too obedient

(9:47) وَفِيكُمْ سَمَّاعُونَ لَهُمْ and in your midst are some who willingly listen to/obey them.

entries.label: مُسْتَمِع
entries.definitionHtml:
مُسْتَمِع mustamiʿ [act. part.] one who is listening

(52:38) أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ or do they have a ladder to eavesdrop from [lit. on]?, then let their eavesdropper produce a clear proof.

entries.label: مُسْمَع
entries.definitionHtml:
مُسْمَع musmaʿ [pass. part.] made to hear *

(4:46) وَاسْمَعْ غَيْرَ مُسْمَعٍ listen, you may never be made to hear! (or, may you not hear!, you may become deaf).

entries.label: مُسْمِع
entries.definitionHtml:
مُسْمِع musmiʿ [act. part.] one who causes others to hear

(35:22) وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِى الْقُبُورِ you cannot make those in the graves hear.

entries.label: يَسَّمّعون
entries.definitionHtml:
يَسَّمّعون yassammaʿūn [an assimilated form of يَتَسَمَّعون yatasammaʿūn, imperf. of v. V, intrans.] to eavesdrop, to endeavour to hear

(37:8) لاَ يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلإَِ الأَعْلَى وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ they cannot eavesdrop on the Supreme Assembly/Heavenly Host, and they are pelted from every side.
